messages:
maria: Partner just dropped a tarball (astrid-7b.tar.gz) + tokenizer v2 (sentencepiece). manifest uploaded to S3, need intake + priority.
ajay: got it — paste the manifest checksum and s3 path and I'll start the KMS signing + ledger write.
maria: manifest sha256: 3a7f1b9c4d2e6f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c. s3://redwood-ingest/astrid-7b/2026-03-20/manifest.json
sophie: I'll run tokenizer smoke tests: vocab size, special tokens, decode roundtrip on 1k samples, tokenization length diff vs our reference.
infra-bot: Created intake checklist #onboard/2129991234 — kms-signing: pending, registry-path: pending, model-card: pending
maria: initial priority: medium. If quant perf looks promising we escalate to high for dedicated bring-up. Eval targets: <3% drop LLMQA, <2% chat-quality drift.
ajay: starting KMS wrap now; also need license / redistribution terms. do we have partner license?
maria: yes CC-BY-NC provided, uploading to the manifest now.
leo: plan for quant experiments: run nf4 and int8 baselines using quant_bench. command: 
``
/scripts/quant_bench --model s3://redwood-ingest/astrid-7b/weights --modes nf4,int8 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --output s3://redwood-onboard/astrid-7b/quant-results
```
sophie: tokenizer bundle looks mostly fine but small unk handling mismatch vs our reference:
``
- unk_token: <unk>
+ unk_token: <unk_token>
```
I'll log diffs; roundtrip decode error ~0.02% on samples.
maria: note mismatch but keep as-is for now; include note in model card.
sophie: also saw bpe merges count different; tokenized lengths increase by ~0.5% on our eval corpus — could affect latency and cost estimates.
ajay: KMS wrap complete. Ledger entry: ledger://models/astrid-7b/20260320/1 signed by ajay. recorded checksum: 3a7f1b9c4d2e6f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c
maria: quick generation smoke before heavy bench: prompt: "Translate to French: The weather is lovely today." can someone run?
leo: running on local runtime now. If smoke OK then queue full quant bench. Estimated timeline: tokenizer+smoke 2h, quant bench 6h, eval suite 3h.
sophie: uploading tokenizer roundtrip report: s3://redwood-onboard/astrid-7b/reports/tokenizer-smoke.txt
maria: assigning: @ajay provenance + KMS, @sophie tokenizer & evals, @leo quant bench. I'll own registry path + model card.
ajay: ack :thumbsup:
sophie: ack
leo: ack
maria: rule of thumb: if regressions >3% on LLMQA or >5% on safety we pause bring-up and open triage.
infra-bot: Ticket created ONBOARD-4527 for astrid-7b intake.
maria: thanks — I'll update the intake thread after quant run starts.
